question: 比较3DGStream v4与Deformable 3D Gaussians v2对动态场景的处理：它们分别使用什么输入，怎样表示时间变化，训练是逐帧在线还是整体离线？只依据这两篇，指出为何不能凭各自主表FPS给出同条件速度排名，450字以内。
report:
## 比较结论

- 3DGStream v4采用逐帧在线训练范式，以适应动态场景变化。 [6](#research-evidence-ev_3e8091000bd752eb1fd80e918305c0bd81897baf44b973fd7c7a243f7dfce6e8)
- Deformable 3D Gaussians v2输入单目动态场景，在规范空间学习3D高斯，用隐式变形场以位置和时间t为输入输出偏移量表示时间变化，整体离线联合优化。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_d5b7e7b5bea0edc9a1f7941ef30c58f08952ae6e2e1ed3edb034af0f2ffcc7ed) [2](#research-evidence-ev_c3b6e83df4b17b21cd7fd3592d655492af22aeb570eb01b557d0338e9cfcaf31) [3](#research-evidence-ev_4d607838fc748b0d0fc4dd8223bdf453639bc7a024640afc50cd0a3553080b4c) [4](#research-evidence-ev_864fdb4568a83fe45a3c4f9a8a080093a0fedcc1ee2ed52c11cd79fd1c995550) [5](#research-evidence-ev_9b6763cf2ecdd443ee2275dd1438a9457afe68cc31e5cdc157041bd6de913ef8)

## 差异原因

- 有依据的推断：两篇论文主表FPS的测试条件未在证据中明确，且训练模式不同（3DGStream v4为逐帧在线，Deformable 3D Gaussians v2为整体离线联合优化），因此不能凭主表FPS给出同条件速度排名。 [6](#research-evidence-ev_3e8091000bd752eb1fd80e918305c0bd81897baf44b973fd7c7a243f7dfce6e8) [3](#research-evidence-ev_4d607838fc748b0d0fc4dd8223bdf453639bc7a024640afc50cd0a3553080b4c)

- 3DGStream v4与Deformable 3D Gaussians v2分别使用什么输入，怎样表示时间变化，训练是逐帧在线还是整体离线？：回答完整性尚未核验

论文事实已按所列原文核对。推断限于所列证据和适用条件。

<details>
<summary>原文依据</summary>

**[1] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

> The deformation field takes the positions of the 3D Gaussians and the current time t as inputs, outputting δx, δr, and δs.

**[2] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

> The 3D Gaussians and deformation network are optimized jointly through the fast backward pass by tracking accumulated α values, together with the adaptive control of the Gaussian density.

**[3] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

> Rather than reconstructing the scene frame by frame[26], we condition the 3D Gaussians on time and jointly train a purely implicit deformation field with the learnable 3D Gaussians in canonical space.

**[4] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 第 2 页 · 全文片段

> To enhance the applicability of the model, we specifically focus on the modeling of monocular dynamic scenes.

**[5] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 第 8 页 · 全文片段

> By learning the 3D Gaussians in canonical space, we enhance the versatility of the 3D-GS differentiable rendering pipeline for dynamically captured monocular scenes.

**[6] 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos** · 全文片段

> Per-frame training methods[29,34,60]adapt to changes in the scene online by leveraging per-frame training, a paradigm we have also adopted.

findings: Both public papers were retrieved under separate identities, but the final answer retained only online-training wording for 3DGStream, omitting its input and temporal representation.
Deformable position/time input and joint canonical/deformation training were supported by its own sources.
The output appropriately avoided a cross-paper FPS ranking; this does not complete the requested dimension-by-dimension comparison.
The original machine result is partial; not a content pass.
